newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian plane makes forced landing at Rome airport.
newsitem.headline: Italian plane makes forced landing at Rome airport.

text.p: An Alitalia passenger plane was forced to make an emergency landing at Rome's Fiumicino airport on Monday after an engine caught fire after takeoff, airport officials said.
The officials said the pilot of Alitalia flight 672 to Rio de Janeiro dumped fuel onto the runway and over the nearby sea.
They said a small fire started on a part of the airport after hot petrol hit dry plants near one of the runways. The fire was put out without incident.
The jet made the emergency landing about an hour after takeoff and the passengers were sent to a Rome hotel for the night.
